(I)--(also Giritra): several names of the god are mentioned: master of all गणस् and भूतस्, and a god of wrath, worshipped for learning;
1: भा. III. १२. १२; IV. २९. ४२; VIII. 5. ३९; II. 2. 7; IV. 2. ३२; 3. 7.
परीक्षित् compared to him for liberality in granting boons: awarded his own missile to Arjuna: a great Yogin. Resident of कैलास; worships San- कऋषण in इलावृत.
2: भा. I. १२. २३; १५. १२; १८. १४; V. १७. १६-24.
Met by Pracatas and venerated by कृष्ण; knew वासु- deva's glory and the dharma ordained by Hari;
3: Ib. IV. २४. १६; X. ४४. १३; I. 9. १९; VI. 3. २०.
pleased with बाण, guarded his city, and fought with कृष्ण. Insulted by दक्ष and भृगु in the sacrifice of प्रजापतिस्: warned सती against attending दक्ष's sacrifice where he was deprived of his share. Heard from नारद of सती's sacrifice and grew angry, out sprang वीरभद्र to ruin the sacrifice; cut off दक्ष's head; waited on by ब्रह्मा and consoled, agreed to attend and praised विष्णु, and felt obliged to him.
4: Ib. VI. १८. १८; IV. Chh. 2-7 (whole); २१. २९; IX. १०. १०.
Appeared before the Pracetasas and initiated them into the रुद्रगीता in glory of Hari and left them;
5: Ib. IV. २४. २५-68; २५. 1; २९. ४२.
praised Aditi and वामन's exploits and was present when he was anointed Upendra;
6: Ib. VIII. २३. २०-27.
praised नृसिम्ह, and prayed to, by प्रह्लाद. His discomfiture at Maya who built three cities for the safety of the Asuras. Them he killed. But Maya brought back all of them to life by the immortalised waters which he discovered in a well. शिव was worried when ब्रह्मा and Hari drank the whole of the liquid. Induced by them he attacked Tripura with success.
7: Ib. VII. 8. ४१; १०. ३२, ५१-68.
Accompanied ब्रह्मा and other gods when they went to meet Hari Ajita. Praised by प्रजापतिस् for consuming हालाहल that came out of अमृतमथन. His faces re- present five उपनिषद्स् from which thirty-eight मन्त्रस् evolved, Himself being the Highest Truth. The poison got [page३-422+ ४७] stuck in his throat and added beauty to his neck. Heard with wonder the मोहिनी form of Hari and came with पार्वती to see him. Requested Hari to show himself again as मोहिनी. Seeing the lovely form शिव became enamoured and ran after her when his seed dropped in several places which ultimately became shrines of images of gold and silver. Then he realis- ed his position and after taking leave of Hari, went to his abode;
8: Ib. VIII. 6 and 7 (whole); १२. 1-४१.
embraced पार्वती sitting on his lap in the midst of his attendants. This was seen by the Vidyadhara Citraketu who laughed at it. So he was cursed by पार्वती to be born an Asura. When शिव appealed to her that Citraketu was Hari's friend, पार्वती became mild;
9: Ib. VI. १७. 1-३६.
had a special park in which he sported with पार्वती. Waited upon by वसिष्ठ, he agreed to let Sudyumna be a male and female in alternate months;
१०: Ib. IX. 1. २५ and २९, ३६-37.
did not comprehend Hari's माया and advised दुर्वासस् pursued by Cakra to go to Hari: prayed to by भगीरथ, offered to bear the waters of the Ganges descend- ing from Heaven after washing the feet of Hari. Joined the gods in the तारकामय war;
११: Ib. IX. 4. ५७-62; 9. 8-9; १४. 6.
worshipped as पशुपति in अम्बिकावन: propitiated with goats in धनुर्याग, went to Hari with ब्रह्मा and attended on Him.
१२: Ib. X. ३४. 2; ३६. २६; ३९. ५३; ४१. १५; X. 1. १९.
Easily pleased by devotees shows grace to them unlike Hari: backed by शक्ति and full of three गुणस्--वैकारिक, Taijasa and तामस, granted Asura वृक what he wanted for his tapas by cutting flesh from his body viz--that he on whose head he placed his hand should die. He wanted to experiment it on शिव himself who took to flight to वैकुण्ठ. Hari is निर्गुण and apart from प्रकृति. In the role of a young ब्रह्मचारिन्, Hari appeared before वृक and said that owing to curse of दक्ष his words would not come true. As a test he could try it on himself. The wicked Asura did so and died to the relief of शिव. शिव welcomed his brother भृगु but the latter did not appreciate it;
१३: Ib. X. ८८ and ८९ (whole).
worshipped by सुदक्षिण, told him of a means to end the slayer of his father. Attended वरुण's sacrifice and युधिष्ठिर's; gave शाल्व an aerial car capable of creating illusion.
१४: Ib. X. ६६. २८-31; ७४. १३; ७६. 4-7.
Arjuna blessed by [page३-423+ ५९] शिव when he called on Him at कैलास, during the battle. In answer to his prayer, शिव protected the delivery room of the द्वारका Brahman;
१५: Ib. X. ७८. [९५ (V) ३२-33]; ८९. ३७.
worshipped by कृष्ण who was blessed with a son Pradyumna: burnt down काम who was reborn as Pradyumna. Pleased with tapas of Rukmi, he gave him a bow: Rode on his bull against कृष्ण taking पारिजात from Indra's abode but गरुड vanquished the bull and made शिव go back.
१६: Ib. X. ५५. [1-3] 1-2; ५७. १४ [1]; ६१. २३ [1-5]; [६५ (V) ४६]; [६६ (V) ३७-49].
At बाण's city he produced महेश्वर ज्वर which was averted by वैष्णव ज्वर। Seeing कृष्ण chopping all the arms of बाण except four, शिव pleaded for his life to which कृष्ण agreed. On this शिव approved of the marriage of उषा with Aniruddha. Went with ब्रह्मा to encourage देवकी;
१७: Ib. ६२. 1-११; ६३ (whole); 2. २५-42.
wondered at मार्कण्डेय's vrata and was pleased with his bhakti.
१८: Ib. XII. 8. १२; १०. 3, १४-38.
श्रीशैल and गोकर्ण are shrines sacred to Him.
१९: Ib. X. ७९. १३ and १९.
(See निलकण्ठ for the legend) of three eyes, riding on bull, holding पिनाक bow, equal to Nandi in strength, attended by यक्षस्, पिशाचस्, भूतस् and विनायकस्: holding the moon on the tuft. Four faces repre- senting Indra, Yama, वरुण and Moon: creator of आदित्यस्, Vasus, Rudras, Maruts, अश्विन्स्, साध्यस्, विध्या- dharas, नागस्, चारणस् and वालखिल्यस्. Decked with sacred ashes, tiger skin for sacred thread;
२०: Br. II. २५. ६८-115; २६. ३१-50.
ज्योतिर्लिङ्ग is माहेश्व- ram balam, the महायोगम्;
२१: Ib. II. २६. ५३.
cursed by sages of दारुवन for enticing their women-folk by his appearing naked, to become an ass and to lose his लिङ्गम्. Darkness overtook the world. ब्रह्मा advised sages to worship शिव in the form of a लिङ्ग. The establishment of लिङ्ग cult, शिव represents Agni and अम्बिका Moon. Bhasma the वीर्य of the Lord;
२२: Ib. II. २७. ४१-113.
on the significance of पाशुपत yogam.
२३: Ib. II. २७. ११६-17.
Appeared to परशु- राम doing penance in the guise of a hunter: blessed परशु- राम with an axe to aid Devas;
२४: Ib. III. २३. 7-६२; २४. ५९-62; ३२. २०.
committed brahmicide by cutting off ब्रह्मा's head, taught astra and सास्त्र to him. Assumes Rudrahood at the end of Kalpa.
२५: Ib. III. २५. २२-24.
A pose of five faces and ten hands.
२६: Ib. III. ३४. ३८; ४२. २२; ४८. 9.; ७२. १६३-4.
ब्रह्मा's praise of: शुक्र's praise of Became अर्धनारीश्वर by worshipping शक्ति.
२७: Ib. II. २५. ६४-76; IV. 5. १५ to ३०.
Praise by दक्ष.
२८: वा. ३०. १८१- २८६.
Blessed भण्ड with an unrivalled rule of ६००० years.
२९: Br. IV. 7. ४९.
As कामेश्वर, he married कामेश्वरी receving wed- [page३-424+ २४] ding presents from all gods present.
३०: Ib. IV. १४. 2; १५. १७.
Married Gauri through the intervention of the seven sages and lived in ओषधिप्रस्थ city of his father-in-law. Wandered with her passing from one hill to the other. Once unable to hear his वीर्य Gauri, left it with Agni who placed it with कृत्तिकस् who offered it to गन्गा, who deposited it in the Saravana forest.
३१: Ib. IV. ३०. ८३; ३६. १८; ३८. ३९.
A son of Atri;
३२: Br. IV. ४३. ७०.
from his eyes came silver;
३३: M. १७. २३; १९६. ४५.
constituting ब्रह्मा, विष्णु, Arka and Rudra and Vasus; this मूर्ति is वासुदेव.
३४: Ib. ५२. १९; वा. २४. ६७; २७. 9, ५१; ४०. २६.
(II)--one of the seven divisions of प्लक्ष with mountains and rivers. भा. V. २०. 3.
(III)--a son of मेधातिथि and founder of the Kingdom of शिव in प्लक्षद्वीप. Br. II. १४. ३७-9; वा. ३३. ३३; Vi. II. 4. 4 and 5.
(IV)--a lake near व्याससरस्. Br. III. १३. ५२.
(V)--a sage of the Auttama epoch. [page३-425+ २४]
(VI)--the name of a गण attributed to विश्रवस्. वा. ६९. २८.
(VII)--a महापुराण. Vi. III. 6. २१.
(I)--a wife of ईशान, the son of Manojava. Br. II. १०. ७८; वा. २७. ५२.
(II)--a R. in कुशद्वीप. Br. II. १९. ६१; Vi. II. 4. ४३.
(III)--a daughter of Hari and (खशा-वा। प्।) the wife of Anila: (Anala-म्। प्।) a Vasu. Br. III. 3. २६. M. 5. २५; वा. ६६. २५; ६९. १७०.
(IV)--a daughter of खश and a राक्षसी; of शै- veya clan. Br. III. 7. १३८.
(VI)--a mind-born mother. M. १७९. १०.
(VII)--a consort of वायु. Vi. I. 8. 8; १५. ११४.
--a group of १२ gods of the epoch of Uttama Manu. Br. II. ३६. २७, ३३.
--disturbed Dhruva's penance. Vi. I. १२. २६.
--a goddess enshrined at Acchoda. M. १३. ४९.
--sacred to शिवनन्द. M. १३. ३८.
--see महेश्वरव्रतम्. M. ९५. 5.

--the father of the मृग which met with मृगि Paras4ura1ma at पुष्कर: a Brahman of कौशिक gotra in the द्राविड country; his sons were converted into deer; after seeing Agastya, went to heaven. Br. III. ३५, ११-34.
--a तीर्थ sacred to the पितृस्. M. २२. ४९.
--an image of; on the left माधव and on the right शिव with शूल; dress and ornaments of. M. २६०. २१-7. [page३-426+ ३१]

(I)--the capital of शिबि;
1: Br. III. ७४. २१.
the city sacred to शिव.
2: M. १३. ५६; १०१. २२; २७८. २४.
(II) or शिवम्--the city of शिव situated in front of Brahmaloka: residence of siddhas, described. Br. IV. 2. २३४, २५८.

--between Brahmaloka and down the अण्ड, the place for men who do not want rebirth; a lac of yojanas in circumference; parapet walls of gold and with lustre; four golden gates adorned with pearls and other pre- cious gems; ever-ringing bells and with pure आचारस्; no death or disease; sacred to शिव; sand and dust are precious stones; divine lotuses half red, half white, half black, in shape like an umbrella; with seven rivers containing padma, utpalam, and pure waters; in the midst १००० pillared palace adorned with स्फटिक, silver, इन्द्रनील, and तोरणस्; everyday festivities at; Trayambaka's house where live लक्ष्मी, Saras- वती, and others with all jewels bringing joy to the Lord with a troop of charming servant maids and Nandi and other गणस्. वा. ४७. ४५; १०१. २३१-292; १११. ४८.
--the kingdom of. M. १२१. ४७.
--one among the eighteen पुराणस्: com- prises २४००० s4lokas. sec. शिव. भा. XII. 7. २३; १३. 4.
--eligible for पार्वण S4ra1ddha. M. १६. 9.
--the region adjoining the Somaka hill in प्लक्ष. Br. II. १४. ३९; १९. १६; वा. ४९. १४. [page३-427+ ३२]

--sacred to जलप्रिया,
1: M. १३. ३३.
the sun to be worship- ped in the form of.
2: Ib. ५५. 5.
--in honour of शिव; leads to the status of वैश्वानर. M. १०१. १२, ८२.
--a kingdom of the west watered by the Sindhu. Br. II. १८. ४८.
--a son of सान्तकर्णि, and father of शिवस्कन्द. Vi. IV. २४. ४८. [page३-428+ ३५]
--a son of Puloman ruled for 7 years. M. २७३. १३.
--sacred to पार्वती. M. १३. ५१.
--(शान्तिकर्ण): an आन्ध्र king. M. २७३. १४.
(I)--a son of मेदशिरस्, and father of यज्ञश्री. भा. XII. 1. २७.
(II)--a son of शिवश्रित and father of यज्ञश्री. Vi. IV. २४. ४८.
(I)--a son of Anavama? (Bahava) and father of Arindama ruled for २८ years; an आन्ध्र. भा. XII. 1. २६; Br. III. ७४. १६७. M. २७३. १२.
(II)--a son of शातकर्णि and father of Gomati- putra. Vi. IV. २४. ४७.
--ruled for २८ years. वा. ९९. ३५४. [page३-429+ २४]
--a name of ललिता. Br. IV. १८. १६.
--the goddess enshrined at शिवकुण्ड. M. १३. ३८.
--fit for श्राद्ध. वा. ७७. ५१.
--see विघ्नेश. Br. IV. ४४. ६५.
